items: Associate message and field with aria-describedby.

responsive-layout-patterns.copy: Responsive validation keeps the message under the field on narrow screens and inside the same form column on wider screens.

viewport-organization.copy: Place validation directly under the field across viewports. When the issue belongs to a row, group, or page, escalate to group validation, Alert Strip, or Dialog.

api-foundations.copy: Inline Validation API exposes field label, optional field preview value, message, state, full-width behavior, field rendering, live announcement behavior, and accessibility ids while Design System owns severity language, state mapping, focus, and recovery. Use field=false or omit value when the message attaches to an existing field.

props.name: id
props.notes: Stable field id used to wire aria-describedby.

props.name: fullWidth
props.notes: Lets the validation field and message fill the owning field column.

props.name: field
props.notes: When true, renders a field preview; when false, renders only the attached validation message.

props.name: live
props.notes: Announces dynamic validation after user action; errors use alert, non-error states use status.

groups.title: Use
items: Write recovery copy that tells users what to fix.
Use success only when confirmation helps the task.
Attach validation to the field that owns the issue without duplicating an existing field.
Render a field preview only in documentation examples or isolated field demos.
Use live=true only after user interaction reveals the message.

groups.title: Avoid
items: Do not use Inline Validation for global outages or page-level policy.
Do not hide validation in Tooltip or Toast.
Do not announce every keystroke as an error.

groups.title: Review
items: Check color, icon, and visible text together.
Escalate group or page issues to the right pattern.

mustTest: Warning and success do not set aria-invalid
Color is not the only severity signal
Message-only usage does not render a duplicate field
live=true maps error to alert and non-error states to status
rejectIf: Validation is detached from the field.
Required recovery is hidden in Toast or Tooltip.
Raw color, spacing, or state values are used.
Validation renders a second field when an owning field already exists.

miel.copy: MIEL treats Inline Validation as field-level recovery: agents can add it when the issue belongs to a specific input, while humans confirm severity, timing, copy, and whether the issue belongs to a group or page-level pattern.
canDecide: Use Inline Validation for field-specific error, warning, success, or info feedback.
Set aria-invalid only for error state.
Keep message visible and tied to the field with aria-describedby; do not duplicate the owning field.
mustAsk: The issue belongs to multiple fields, a group, or the whole page.
Validation timing could interrupt typing or create noisy announcements.
The recovery copy needs product, policy, or legal approval.
rejectIf: Inline Validation replaces Toast, Alert Strip, Dialog, or group validation.
The message is not attached to a specific field.
The state is only communicated by color or icon.
miel.handoff: I am using Inline Validation for field-level feedback. I need confirmation on severity, timing, recovery copy, field association, and whether this issue belongs to a broader pattern.
